message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Finnish Broadcasting Company Program Research: Audience Surveys 1960-1969","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13525","justification":"Time series of media and broadcasting audience surveys conducted by Yleisradio (Finnish Broadcasting Company) throughout the 1960s in Finland; directly about media consumption in that decade."},{"title":"Press, Radio and Television in Finland 1966","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12984","justification":"Survey on use of newspapers, radio, and television in Finland in 1966; explicitly focused on media behavior and attitudes in the mid‑1960s."},{"title":"Use of Mass Media and Political Communication in Finland 1962","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12817","justification":"Study of mass media use (press, radio, early TV) and political communication among Finns in 1962; covers media exposure and channels."},{"title":"Mass Communication and Newspaper Reading in Finland 1963","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13002","justification":"Dataset on newspaper readership and mass communication patterns in Finland in 1963; focused on print media use and information sources."},{"title":"Television and Radio in Finnish Households 1965","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13147","justification":"Survey of the diffusion and use of television and radio sets in Finnish households in 1965; directly about broadcast media availability and use."},{"title":"Media Habits of Young People in Finland 1968","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13291","justification":"Concentrates on media consumption patterns (press, radio, TV, film) among Finnish youth in 1968; gives age‑specific view of media in late 1960s."},{"title":"Press Freedom and Newspaper Structure in Finland 1960","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13401","justification":"Study of the structure of the Finnish press and issues of press freedom around 1960; relevant for institutional/media‑system aspects rather than audiences."},{"title":"Content Analysis of Finnish Newspapers 1964","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13672","justification":"Systematic content analysis of Finnish newspapers conducted in 1964; focuses on media content rather than audience behavior."},{"title":"Use of Foreign Media and Information Sources in Finland 1967","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13354","justification":"Examines Finns’ use of foreign radio, TV and press in 1967; relevant for international/media‑flow aspects in the Finnish context."},{"title":"Political Information and Mass Media in Finland 1969","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13703","justification":"Survey on how Finns obtained political information from mass media (press, radio, TV) in 1969; end‑of‑decade view of media’s political role."}]}
